method: Deterministic read-only audit of the generated 15-pillar by 10-criterion matrix and coverage register. No cell is marked complete automatically.

matrix.completion_policy: Candidate matches are not evidence of criterion completion; reviewed decisions require a release.

priority_order: SOURCE_GAP pillars: taxonomy and source readiness first
EVIDENCE_READY pillars: criterion-level evidence and human rationale
COMPLETE only after all applicable criteria are explicitly reviewed
conclusion: The generated matrix is structurally present but all 150 cells remain UNASSESSED; coverage completion requires explicit criterion-level review.
